2. VICTIM X THROUGH P.S. BAGLI DISTRICT DEWAS  (MADHYA PRADESH)
 
 ( SHRI N .S .BHATI, GOVT. APPEARING ON BEHALF OF ADVOCATE  GENERAL).
 This application coming on for orders this day, th e cou  following:
 ORDER
They are heard.
Perused the case diary / challan papers.

This is the applicant's first application under Section 439 of Criminal Procedure Code, 1973, as he / she is arrested in connection with Crime No.656/2022 registered at Police Station-Bagli, Dewas (MP) for offence punishable under Sections 363, 366(A), 376, 376(3) of the IPC, under Section 3/4 of POCSO Act.
The applicant is in jail since 17.12.2022.

The allegation against the applicant is of involvement in the aforesaid case wherein the prosecutrix was subjected to rape by the co-accused who happens to be the brother in law of the applicant being the younger brother of the applicant.

sentences.text: Counsel for the applicant has submitted that there is no direct allegation of involvement of the present applicant in the aforesaid offence as the applicant only asked the prosexutrix to meet her brother in law and even in her statement under Section 164 of the Cr.P.C.she has not alleged any overt act against the present applicant.
It is further submitted that the applicant is lodged in jail since 17.12.2022 and the final conclusion of the trial is likely to take a long time.
Thus, it is submitted that the application be allowed.
Counsel for the State, on the other hand, has opposed the prayer.

Having considered the rival submissions and on perusal of the case diary including the statements of the prosecutrix, this Court finds force with the contentions raised by the learned counsel for the applicant.
Accordingly, without commenting anything on merits of the matter, the present application for grant of bail is allowed.

The applicant is directed to be released on bail upon his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.25,000/- (Rupees Twenty Five Thousand only) with one surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the Trial Court for his appearance, as and when directed.
It is also directed that the applicant will abide by all the conditions enumerated under Section 437 (3) Criminal Procedure Code, 1973.
Certified copy as per rules.
